D.t: Don Davis leads by 4.4 in the forecast and wins 76% of simulations. The cushion is about 13,854 votes; a one point swing is about 1,578 voters changing sides.
In 8 of 10 simulations the result lands between R +3.6 and D +12.5. A normal polling error decides it.
